blurb: Potek Winery produces single-vineyard wines from Santa Barbara County's finest sites, including Bien Nacido, Sanford & Benedict, Demetria, and Tierra Alta. Each vintage is hand-sorted, whole-cluster fermented where appropriate, and aged until ready. The winery offers seated tastings in an indoor lounge and walk-in service on the patio.
